ModMetaData.name: Empire Warfare (帝國參戰)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
World war finally reaches the player's empire. When a Rim War warband crushes the defense of one of your Empire (Refactored) vassal settlements, the settlement can now actually fall: it leaves your empire and becomes a regular settlement of the attacking faction, fully registered into Rim War's world simulation. Recapture it later with Empire's existing Capture military job to close the conquest loop.

Features:
- Vassal settlements can be conquered when their defense fails (master toggle, on by default).
- Configurable fall conditions: a single crushing defeat (default) and/or N consecutive defense failures.
- Grace period for new vassals and fresh saves.
- Optional pacing knob exposing Rim War's vassal heat gate (how often warbands pick your vassals as targets).
- Recapture letter when you take a fallen settlement back.

Requires Empire (Refactored) and Rim War. All defense flow (1-day warning, auto/manual battles, reinforcement) is provided by Empire's built-in Rim War bridge; this mod only rewrites the defeat consequence.
